#!name=CSDN
#!author=queitstart pro
#!date=2026-11-21
#!format=sgmodule

[URL Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/app-gw\.csdn\.net\/silkroad-api\/api\/v\d\/assemble\/list\/pub\/channel\/app_open_screen_ad/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/app-gw\.csdn\.net\/abtesting\/v2\/getList?/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/gw\.csdn\.net\/cms-app\/v\d+\/home_page\/open_advertisement/i then reject(404)

[Rule]
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, ad.csdn.net,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, counter.csdn.net,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, dc.csdn.net,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, dc2.csdn.net,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, medal.blog.csdn.net,REJECT

[MITM]
hostname = %APPEND% app-gw.csdn.net, gw.csdn.net
